map.圆台侧面积 S=π(R+r)·l（l 为母线长，l=√((R−r)²+h²)）。: Frustum lateral area S=π(R+r)·l (l is the slant height, l=√((R−r)²+h²)). This tool gives the volume; the lateral area can be computed with this formula, for example with R=3, r=1, h=4: l=√(4+16)=4.472, S=π×4×4.472≈56.23 m².

map.把圆台看成“用一个平行截面截掉小圆锥后的剩余体”；当 r=0（上底缩为一点）即圆: Think of the frustum as "what remains after cutting a small cone off with a parallel section"; when r=0 (top shrunk to a point) it is a cone, and when R=r (equal top and bottom) it is a cylinder, so all three share the same radius/height parameters and can be switched.

map.：例：R=3m、r=1m、h=4m → R²+Rr+r²=9+3+1=13、V=: : Example: R=3m, r=1m, h=4m → R²+Rr+r²=9+3+1=13, V=π×4/3×13=54.4543 m³. If R=r=2m, h=4m (degenerating to a cylinder) → V=π×4/3×12=50.2655 m³, exactly matching the cylinder formula πr²h=π×4×4.
map.：算法：圆台（截头圆锥）体积 V = π·h/3·(R²+R·r+r²)，R 下: : algorithm: frustum (truncated cone) volume V = π·h/3·(R²+R·r+r²), where R is the bottom radius, r the top radius and h the height. Special cases: R=r degenerates to a cylinder V=πr²h; r=0 degenerates to a cone V=πR²h/3. Requires R,r,h>0.
